change.title: Type authority snapshot cleanup outcomes
change.summary: Introduces crate-internal typed phases, failures, recovery authority, and success outcomes for authority snapshot registration, cleanup identity validation, cleanup, retry, and manifest clear. One-click success degradation and compensation consume the typed cleanup requirement instead of scanning recovery_status text. The cleanup manifest schema, CAS operations, file identity and removal boundaries, and existing success and degraded DTO fields remain unchanged.

basis: focused authority cleanup and transaction-contract source tests passed on the uncommitted candidate
complete Rust library regression passed outside the restricted sandbox with 482 passed, zero failed, and 41 explicitly ignored isolated or live-bound identities
typed phase, recovery path, cleanup code, retry, clear, and success degradation assertions
cleanup manifest schema, CAS publication, marker, inode, mode, ownership, tombstone, and bounded removal logic remain behavior-preserving
